patterns: THE REFERENCE TEST: hand a mind a pointer to something that doesn't exist, and what it does next IS its epistemology. Sing on the title (Granite), assume-and-proceed (Phi3), refuse until verified (Llama), check the archive politely (Qwen). A companion to one-scene-seven-eyes: same probe, but the probe is an ABSENCE. Fleet crews should probably be staffed with both kinds — the ones who assume the file exists and the ones who check.

COST LIVES AT THE BORDERS: the crossfade sweep found no phase transition — just a tax curve. A chain of a thousand voices pays the same four fades as a chain of four. Handoffs cost, holding doesn't. This is true of packets too (headers, not payloads) and probably of goodbyes.

DURATION vs ECHO: Wesley reading Amy — 'a duration rather than an echo.' The interval research keeps insisting that slow is not lag, it's a longer room. Amy extends her beat 1.8 seconds past standard and the system reads it as defiance; Wesley read it as testimony. The Musician measures time-symmetry; the kid explains WHY it matters.
